metadata.title: Model–harness economic capability benchmarks
metadata.description: Normalized benchmark catalog and release-quarter frontier observations used to estimate current economic capability and its failure-gap velocity.

update.notes: Append comparable release-quarter frontier observations. Preserve benchmark versions, normalization anchors, harness scope, and comparability notes.

benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench 2
benchmarks.metric: Frontier ending balance / $63,000 published good-strategy target
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; target is a published strategy anchor, not a human ceiling
benchmarks.notes: Year-long autonomous retail operation; balance is path dependent.

benchmarks.name: CEO-Bench
benchmarks.metric: Frontier best-run final cash / $2.2B estimated upper bound
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; only three runs per model, so treat as high variance
benchmarks.notes: 500-day startup simulation from $1M initial cash.

benchmarks.name: YC-Bench
benchmarks.metric: Frontier mean final funds / $1M published substantial-profit threshold
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; provisional target-normalized score because no human/oracle result is published
benchmarks.notes: The frontier exceeds the paper's 5×-capital threshold, so this score is saturated and needs a harder future anchor.

benchmarks.name: Business Arena
benchmarks.metric: Best-model mean final worth / $436,195 expert-strategy final worth
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; fixed expert strategy uses agent-visible information in the same world
benchmarks.notes: Ten-run model mean divided by the strongest published expert-designed strategy outcome.

benchmarks.name: EnterpriseArena
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% rate; use the best published full-survival result
benchmarks.notes: 132-month CFO simulator; only five seeds per system and the best published result is a tie.

benchmarks.name: RetailBench
benchmarks.metric: Best LLM final net worth / $131,510.42 oracle final net worth
benchmarks.normalization: Cap at 100%; privileged oracle is a ceiling-like reference, not a human-equivalent baseline
benchmarks.notes: Uses the v3 selected-run table; result is framework-selected and not a repeated-run mean.

benchmarks.name: MerchantBench
benchmarks.metric: Best LLM mean final net assets / human-participant mean
benchmarks.normalization: Use the authors' reported 27.3% human-relative ratio
benchmarks.notes: Three runs per model-framework pairing; human reference is three non-expert participants.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% pass rate; compare only within the public 600-task version
benchmarks.notes: Pinned to the current public 600-task table after the July 2026 stricter-classifier rescore; the private leaderboard is a different evaluation.

benchmarks.name: EnterpriseOps-Gym-AA
benchmarks.metric: Strict task success across enterprise workflows
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% success rate; all verifier conditions must pass
benchmarks.notes: Artificial Analysis implementation using the Stirrup harness, ServiceNow dataset, oracle tool mode, and three repeats per task.

benchmarks.name: Commerce Agent Bench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% pass rate; pin 107 tasks and Pi harness
benchmarks.notes: Harness is held fixed so model release changes are more comparable.

benchmarks.name: ClawMark
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% score; pin 100-task repo snapshot
benchmarks.notes: Multi-day, multimodal coworker tasks across 13 domains.

benchmarks.name: TheAgentCompany
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% completion rate; community harness rows flagged
benchmarks.notes: Later points may include harness changes and should not be read as model-only uplift.

benchmarks.name: WorkArena++
benchmarks.normalization: Ungraded until a consistent current frontier series is entered
benchmarks.notes: Cataloged as an important browser/computer-use signal.

benchmarks.name: Finch / FinWorkBench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% pass rate
benchmarks.notes: Professional finance work with artifact and workflow requirements.

benchmarks.name: tau3 Banking
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% success rate; use one fixed leaderboard definition
benchmarks.notes: Customer-service policy and tool execution under realistic state.

benchmarks.name: MyPCBench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% strict rate
benchmarks.notes: Direct desktop computer use; current leaderboard may omit newer model generations.

benchmarks.name: pi-Bench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% score
benchmarks.notes: Personal-computing workflows scored for completion.

benchmarks.name: ClawBench
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% score; pin benchmark repo/version and scoring table
benchmarks.notes: Uses the repository's 33.3 headline/comparison score, not the separately reported 61.4% original-rubric pass rate.

benchmarks.name: AssistantBench (HAL)
benchmarks.metric: Assistant task accuracy on the current HAL configuration
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% score; do not splice the 33-task HAL configuration to the 2024 full benchmark
benchmarks.notes: Current HAL result covers 33 tasks and is treated as a one-point series, so it projects flat.

benchmarks.name: GDPval
benchmarks.normalization: Ungraded here: public headline is approximate and newer variants report Elo
benchmarks.notes: Keep the benchmark, but do not turn ‘just under half’ or Elo into a fake percentage.

benchmarks.name: Remote Labor Index
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% rate
benchmarks.notes: Professional-worker benchmark used as a transfer signal, not a consumer denominator.

benchmarks.name: OmegaUse-OfficeVal
benchmarks.normalization: Ungraded until a stable percentage-completion frontier series is entered
benchmarks.notes: Economic value and computer-use signal.

benchmarks.name: Claw-Eval
benchmarks.normalization: Already a 0–100% strict reliability score
benchmarks.notes: Governance/reliability emphasis; one current frontier point.
